## Initial population state

@fig-initial-population presents a cross-sectional snapshot of agent
psychological states before the first simulation day. Baseline
resilience, affect, and resources are sampled independently, and the
PSS-10 score is derived from its item responses, so the population
starts from a neutral point. No pairwise association exceeds
`r baseline_max_corr()` in magnitude, and the PSS-10--stress correlation is
`r baseline_corr("pss10", "current_stress")`. This absence of
predetermined relationships is intentional. Any associations observed at
the end state should therefore reflect emerged associations from the model's
dynamics rather than from biased initial conditions.

![Cross-sectional visualization of agent psychological states at baseline, highlighting uncorrelated randomly generated distributions](figures/full_model_initial_population.pdf){#fig-initial-population}
